decision.explanation: The question asks for the population of 'Licking Township', which refers to multiple distinct entities across different locations. Source D1/D2 confirms 7,899 (2010 census) for Licking Township, Blackford County, Indiana. Source D3 confirms 7,723 (2020 census) for the same Indiana location. Source D5 confirms 3,870 (2000 census) for Licking Township, Licking County, Ohio. Source D6/D7 confirms 536 (2010 census) for Licking Township, Clarion County, Pennsylvania. All four values correspond to distinct valid referents identified in the source text and are retained as complementary answers.
